thread:
elaine_cs: FYI HelioLabs hit an unexpected embedding surge overnight. Ops alerted me and the account is now at ~82% of monthly credits. Need a crisp token-econ snapshot + two forecast scenarios for QBR: conservative and optimized.

garrett_finops: Got it. Do we have recent infra changes that could explain the spike? Also please confirm their embedding dim & model.

elaine_cs: They moved to dense-retrieval with 1536-d vectors and full index rebuild on 2026-03-04. Embeds are ~75% of their spend.

mike_onboard: Yep, I pushed the full index. It was intentional for recall but I flagged the higher compute. Noted.

nina_csm: For the QBR I'll need a 1-line risk statement and recommended ask (e.g., commit vs throttle vs enable cache). Also capture customer quote: they called "cost unpredictability" out in the last sync.

alerts-bot: ALERT: HelioLabs usage >80% of monthly credits. Notified billing@heliolabs.com.

garrett_finops: Running quick scenarios. Assumptions: baseline monthly embed spend = $24,800; scenario A (growth +1.4x) = $34,720; scenario B (cache + quant + batching) = $15,800 (approx). Will post calc snippet.

garrett_finops: ```calc
baseline_embed: $24,800
scenario_conservative (1.4x): $34,720
scenario_optimized (cache 35% + q4_32-ish 25%): $15,800 est
credit_runway now: 18 days -> 26 days optimized
```

mike_onboard: For enablement I can run a 45min deep-dive on cache setup + index best practices. Recommend 30m pre-call with infra to agree on rollout.

elaine_cs: Good. Nina can you own the QBR slide copy? Garrett add a 1-paragraph appendix with commit-sizing that keeps per-embed under $0.0018 in our model.

nina_csm: Yep. Drafting: "Risk: Rapid embedding growth and index rebuilds have driven a 3x cost spike; recommended mitigation is prefix caching + quantized embed model or a short-term commit to stabilize unit price." Will include a customer-facing action checklist.

garrett_finops: One more ask: are we assuming latency slack of up to +35ms for quantized lookups? That affects cost/quality tradeoffs.

mike_onboard: Yes that's fine; Helio is okay with slight latency increase for lower cost.

elaine_cs: Please add tasks to the QBR workbook and tag owners. Deliver final numbers and bullets by Thursday 6pm PT. I'll assemble slides Friday AM.

mike_onboard: Adding calendar invites. Tentative - Wed/Thu next week for enablement.

garrett_finops: Uploaded the scenario spreadsheet and notes: https://redwood.internal/sheets/helio-qbr-2026. I'll drop a pinned calc in the workbook.

nina_csm: :thumbsup: capturing customer sentiment + renewal ask. I'll include a recommended outreach script for the AMR.

elaine_cs: Thanks team. If we can also propose an "auto-throttle" opt-in for burst windows that would be useful for the customer. I'll surface that in the QBR.

alerts-bot: NOTE: Task created #CS-8829 for HelioLabs QBR prep (assigned: garrett_finops, nina_csm, mike_onboard).
